name: Hoodkins
description: Hoodkins is a 10,000-piece collection of looping chibi-raccoon PFP GIFs on Robinhood Chain. Each raccoon is stacked from six layers — pad, glow, pelt, fit, mug, and gear — then flattened onto one 12-frame GIF. Thick outlines. Flat fills. Bandit masks. Streetwear. Ears twitch. Eyes blink. Soft bob.
